description: 3D multi-source paper cloud visualization (arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv)

stories.title: Unified Paper Model
stories.description: Define a frozen pydantic BaseModel for papers from any source. Normalize identifiers into unified uid; keep id (source-native) and doi distinct (arXiv id is not a DOI). Include source, title, categories, published date, version, authors, abstract, optional citations.
acceptance: Paper is a frozen pydantic BaseModel (frozen=True, extra=forbid)
Hypothesis roundtrip tests pass for all source types

stories.title: Canonical CSV Adapter
stories.description: Parse weekly canonical CSV files from gha-rxiv-feed-action (Date,ISOWeek,DOI,Version,Category,Title,Authors,Abstract) into Paper objects. One loader for all sources (arXiv conforms via gha-rxiv-feed-action#107; its id rides in the DOI column). Handle multi-category papers (semicolon-separated). Deduplicate by (uid, version).
acceptance: Parses real canonical CSV samples for all three sources
Returns list[Paper] sorted by published date

stories.title: Multi-Source Selection
stories.description: Tag source (arxiv/biorxiv/medrxiv) from the data directory (data/<server>/). The canonical loader handles every server; there is no separate per-server adapter.
acceptance: medrxiv and biorxiv distinguished by directory, not schema

stories.title: Multi-Source Ingestion
stories.description: Combine sources via a registry. Ingest from multiple data directories. Deduplicate across sources by uid. Return sorted list of Paper objects.
acceptance: Registry maps source names to the canonical loader
Ingests from multiple directories in one call

stories.title: UMAP Layout Engine
stories.description: Compute 3D positions from paper category vectors using UMAP. One-hot encode categories, reduce to 3 dimensions. Z-axis weighted by publication date. Deterministic with fixed seed.
acceptance: Output has x, y, z per paper
Similar categories cluster together (cosine distance test)

stories.title: SQLite + Positions Export
stories.description: Emit a compact Float32Array positions binary (hot render path) and a SQLite papers.db (cold metadata). papers.db: uid, source, title, categories (JSON), published, version, authors, abstract, doi, x, y, z, r. Index source and published. FTS5 on title, authors, abstract.
acceptance: papers.db contains all papers with positions
Positions binary holds x,y,z + color/size per point
FTS5 search on title/authors/abstract returns correct results
Indexes exist on source and published columns

stories.title: Pipeline CLI
stories.description: pydantic AppSettings(BaseSettings, cli_parse_args=True) CLI (no Click), exposed as [project.scripts] paperverse, with subcommands ingest, layout, export. Support --sources, --data-dir, --output, --seed. End-to-end CSV dirs to papers.db + positions binary.
acceptance: CLI runs end-to-end: CSV dirs → papers.db + positions binary
Exit code 0 on success, non-zero on error

stories.title: Three.js Scene Setup
stories.description: Create Three.js scene (TypeScript) with WebGPU renderer and WebGL2 fallback. OrbitControls for rotate/zoom/pan. Responsive canvas filling viewport. Defaults to user's system theme (prefers-color-scheme); EyeRest tokens by pointer.
acceptance: Scene renders an empty viewport in the active system theme
WebGL2 fallback works when WebGPU unavailable

stories.title: Paper Points Rendering
stories.description: Load the positions binary into a BufferGeometry Points buffer (hot path); open papers.db via sql.js for lazy metadata. Per-point color encodes source via the zero-blue EyeRest palette. Handle 100K+ points at 60fps.
acceptance: Points render from the positions binary
Colors distinguish sources via the zero-blue EyeRest palette (never a blue accent)
sql.js WASM loads and lazily queries metadata

stories.title: Interaction
stories.description: Raycasting on Points for hover detection. Tooltip with title on hover. Click lazily queries full metadata from SQLite. Detail panel shows title, authors, categories, source, date.
acceptance: Click opens detail panel with full metadata
SQL query returns correct paper for clicked point

stories.title: Full-Text Search
stories.description: FTS5 query via sql.js on title/authors/abstract. Search input with debounced query. Highlight matching points. Animate camera to centroid of results.

stories.title: GitHub Pages Deployment
stories.description: GitHub Actions workflow: install uv, run pipeline CLI, build the Vite ui/ to dist/, deploy to GitHub Pages. Trigger on push to main.
acceptance: Live site loads and renders the paper cloud
